carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple horizontal linear features are visible across the upper flank, displaying a pronounced vertical intensity gradient with high-luminance values along the top edge and distinct shadowing along the ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: The visible pectoral fin exhibits a high spatial density of smaller, less uniform high-luminance blobs compared to the primary lateral flank pattern.
